title: Sign sum on a dimension edge
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, choose a coordinate $i$ among $m+1$ coordinates, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^{m+1}$ satisfy $x_i=1$. The sum of the signs of all coordinates of $x$ is $1$ plus the sum of the signs in the $m$-coordinate vector obtained by deleting coordinate $i$.
